to occur, to present itself; to offer, to arise

exercises.why: From Wiktionary: останови́ть — to stop, to bring to stop; представля́ться — to occur, to present itself; to offer, to arise; постоя́нный — constant, permanent; представле́ние — introduction (a means, such as a personal letter, of presenting one person to another).
